short: Wholistic Medical Group is a Tampa-based integrative healthcare practice founded by Dr. Duke Mansell, DOM, AP. We combine functional medicine, acupuncture, functional nutrition, dry needling and natural therapies to help patients with persistent concerns including digestive issues, chronic fatigue, pain and inflammation, hormone health, headaches and migraines. Our approach looks beyond individual symptoms to understand contributing factors and support better overall function and long-term health.
certs: Nationally Board Certified by the NCCAOM (National Certification Commission for Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine) Doctor of Oriental Medicine (DOM); Acupuncture Physician (AP), Florida
training: Graduated Summa Cum Laude from East West College of Natural Medicine’s Traditional Chinese Medicine graduate program with a degree in Acupuncture and Oriental Medicine. Recipient of the TCM Honor Award for exceptional clinical skills. Clinical training included the East West College of Natural Medicine Health Clinic and HealthSouth Rehabilitation Hospital of Sarasota.
pricing: Initial appointment: $350. Follow-up appointments: $90. Four-visit follow-up package: $320. Monthly membership: $99. Free 15-minute consultation available. HSA/FSA accepted; superbills available for patients seeking possible out-of-network reimbursement.
long: Wholistic Medical Group is a Tampa-based integrative healthcare practice founded by Dr. Duke Mansell, DOM, AP, in 2016. We combine functional medicine, acupuncture, functional nutrition, dry needling and natural therapies with a systems-based approach to health. We work with patients experiencing persistent concerns including digestive issues, chronic fatigue and low energy, chronic pain and inflammation, hormone health, headaches and migraines. Rather than focusing only on individual symptoms, our approach considers contributing factors across the body and develops individualized strategies designed to support better function and long-term health. In-person care is available in Tampa, with telehealth options also available.
size: 4–5 days per week, approximately 20–25 new patients per month, while maintaining a personalized, physician-led practice.
